existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: No fee to examine or review records
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: No fee may be charged to examine or review a public record, or to determine whether a record is subject to disclosure, except as provided in this Section.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: No fee shall be charged to any person to examine or review any public records, except as provided in this Section, and no fee shall be charged for examination or review to determine if a record is subject to disclosure, except as may be determined by a court of competent jurisdiction.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Examination fee fixed at zero; copy fees governed separately (LA-0021).

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: The custodian may establish and collect reasonable fees for making copies of public records.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: The custodian may establish and collect reasonable fees for making copies of public records, which may include the transmission of electronic copies of public records.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Soft-standard: the state supplies only a 'reasonable' constraint; the municipality sets the operative per-page/per-item value. No statutory numeric cap for local bodies.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Establish and post a reasonable fee schedule
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: A custodian who elects to collect copying fees shall establish a reasonable fee schedule and post it where it can be readily accessed by the public.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Custodian elects to establish and collect copy fees
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Any custodian who elects to establish and collect such fees shall establish a reasonable fee schedule and post the schedule where it can be readily accessed by the public.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Conditional structural requirement triggered by electing to charge.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Custodian may request payment in advance of production
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: The custodian may request payment of fees in advance of production.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: The custodian may request payment of fees in advance of production.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Copies may be withheld for nonpayment or outstanding balance
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: The custodian need not provide copies where the requester fails to pay applicable copying fees after advance notice of the amount, or has an outstanding balance from a prior request.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Requester fails to pay after advance notice OR has an outstanding prior balance
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: it shall be the duty of the custodian of the public records to provide copies to persons so requesting, unless the requestor fails to pay the applicable copying fees after being notified of the amount in advance of production or the requestor has an outstanding balance from a prior request.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Production gate; branches the request to a hold-for-payment state.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Waiver or reduction for indigent citizens
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Copies of records may be furnished without charge or at a reduced charge to indigent citizens of the state.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Requester is an indigent citizen of Louisiana
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Copies of records may be furnished without charge or at a reduced charge to indigent citizens of this state.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Discretionary waiver; limited to indigent 'citizens of this state.'

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: State-agency copies charged per uniform schedule adopted by commissioner of administration
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: For state-agency public records, copy fees shall be charged according to the uniform fee schedule adopted by the commissioner of administration (R.S. 39:241) or as otherwise fixed by law.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Request is to a state agency
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Fees for such copies shall be charged according to the uniform fee schedule adopted by the commissioner of administration as provided by R.S. 39:241 or as otherwise fixed or provided by law.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Agency-specific: applies to STATE agencies, NOT municipalities (which use the reasonable-fee standard, LA-0021). Included for cross-state overlap with 'statewide fee schedule set by a central agency' concept.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: When examination is conducted outside regular working hours, persons representing the custodian are entitled to reasonable compensation, paid by the public body and funded in advance by the party demanding the extraordinary examination.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Examination authorized outside regular office/working hours
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Custodian's representatives who supervise examination in other than regular working hours shall be entitled to reasonable compensation to be paid to them by the public body having custody of such record, out of funds provided in advance by the person examining such record in other than regular working hours.
